settings.title: What is GOVX ID?
settings.content: GOVX ID is a secure verification platform that confirms your status as a military member, veteran, first responder, or teacher. It allows you to instantly unlock exclusive Tribe Organics discounts without sharing personal documents directly with us.

settings.title: Who qualifies for the GOVX discount?
settings.content: Eligible groups include active-duty and retired U.S. military, veterans, first responders (police, fire, EMS), and teachers. If you’re not sure, you can check your eligibility during the quick GOVX ID verification.

settings.title: How do I verify my status and get my 15% discount?
settings.content: Just click the “Verify with GOVX ID” button on this page. You’ll be directed to GOVX’s secure site to confirm your eligibility. Once verified, you’ll instantly receive a unique single-use code for 15% off when you spend $100 or more every 24 hours.

settings.title: Can I combine the GOVX discount with other promos or subscriptions?
settings.content: No, the GOVX discount can’t be combined with other site-wide sales, promo codes, or subscription discounts. If there’s a larger promotion running, you can choose whichever offer gives you the best savings.

settings.title: Do I need to verify every time I shop?
settings.content: You’ll only verify once. After that, simply log in with your GOVX ID to receive a new code whenever you shop. Each discount code is single-use to keep your savings secure and exclusive.
